content.answer: For odd prime $p$, $M_p$ is prime iff $s_{p-2} \equiv 0 \pmod{M_p}$ with $s_0 = 4$, $s_{k+1} = s_k^2 - 2$.
acceptableAnswers: For odd prime p, M_p is prime iff s_(p-2) ≡ 0 (mod M_p) with s_0 = 4, s_(k+1) = s_k^2 - 2.

content.answer: Even perfect numbers are exactly $2^{p-1}(2^p - 1)$ with $2^p - 1$ a (Mersenne) prime.
acceptableAnswers: Even perfect numbers are exactly 2^(p-1)(2^p - 1) with 2^p - 1 a (Mersenne) prime.

content.answer: $\mu(1) = 1$; $\mu(n) = 0$ if $n$ has a squared prime factor; otherwise $(-1)^k$ for $k$ distinct primes.
acceptableAnswers: μ(1) = 1; μ(n) = 0 if n has a squared prime factor; otherwise (-1)^k for k distinct primes.

cards.sourceRef: Hardy & Wright, An Introduction to the Theory of Numbers (Oxford)

content.answer: If $g(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} f(d)$, then $f(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} \mu(n/d)\, g(d)$.
acceptableAnswers: If g(n) = Σ over d|n of f(d), then f(n) = Σ over d|n of μ(n/d) g(d).
